welcome.description: First screen new users see before any onboarding. Legal disclaimer is inline below the primary CTAs.

title.description: Hero title on the welcome screen. Short greeting (e.g. 'Welcome, friend').

subtitle.description: Hero subtitle below the welcome title.

get_started.description: Primary CTA that begins onboarding for a new user.

use_existing_account.description: Secondary CTA for returning users who already have an account.

legal_disclaimer_prefix.description: First inline-text fragment of the legal disclaimer shown under the CTAs. Followed by the Terms link, the connector, and the Privacy Policy link. Include any required trailing space.

legal_disclaimer_and.description: Connector word between the Terms link and the Privacy Policy link in the inline disclaimer. Include any required surrounding spaces (e.g. ' & ').

legal_terms.description: Inline link label that opens the in-app Terms & Conditions webview.

legal_privacy_policy.description: Inline link label that opens the in-app Privacy Policy webview.

privacy_policy_title.description: Title of the in-app webview screen that displays the Privacy Policy. The Privacy Policy body itself is the CMS page referenced by wm-app-config.privacyPolicyPage, not a translation string.

terms_and_conditions_title.description: Title of the in-app webview screen that displays the Terms & Conditions. The body itself is the CMS page referenced by wm-app-config.termsAndConditionsPage.

email_app_unavailable.description: Error toast shown when the OS cannot find an installed email client to handle a mailto: link from the welcome screen.

link_open_failed.description: Generic error toast shown when an inline link on the welcome screen fails to open.

onboarding_name.description: Onboarding step where the new user enters their first name.

title.description: Screen prompt asking the user for their name (e.g. “What’s your name?”).

placeholder.description: Input field placeholder hint for the name field.

continue.description: Primary CTA to confirm the entered name and continue onboarding.

onboarding_greeting.description: Brief greeting screen shown immediately after the user enters their name.

message_prefix.description: Multi-line greeting prefix shown above the user’s name. Preserve the embedded line breaks (\n) — they control where the text wraps in the hero layout.

onboarding_user_type.description: Onboarding step where the user self-classifies (complete beginner, tried before, attending classes, yogi). Drives downstream personalisation and the analytics yogi-exclusion gate.

title_prefix.description: First text fragment of the screen title. Combined with title_brand and title_suffix to form the full prompt (e.g. 'Have you tried Sahaja Yoga before?'). Preserve the trailing line break (\n).

title_brand.description: The 'Sahaja Yoga' brand fragment in the title. Usually kept in original spelling, with optional locale-script transliteration.

title_suffix.description: Closing text fragment of the title (typically ' before?'). Include the leading space if needed for the locale.

get_started.description: Primary CTA used after the user picks their classification.

option_complete_beginner.description: Selectable option for users completely new to meditation. Maps to userType = user-complete-beginner.

option_tried_before.description: Selectable option for users who have tried meditation before but not deeply. Maps to userType = user-tried-before.

option_attending_classes.description: Selectable option for users currently in an in-person or online newcomer class. Maps to userType = user-attending-classes.

option_yogi.description: Selectable option for long-time Sahaja Yoga practitioners. Maps to userType = yogi (excluded from the ad-measurement path).

onboarding_carousel.description: Three-slide intro carousel shown early in onboarding.

page_true_self_prefix.description: Slide 2 title prefix; combined inline with page_true_self_highlight (e.g. 'Get to know your true self'). Include the trailing space.

page_true_self_highlight.description: Highlighted phrase at the end of slide 2 title, typically rendered in an accent colour (e.g. 'true self').

general.description: Generic UI strings shared across the app (overlays, error states, simple actions).

back.description: Generic back action label (used as accessibility text and as a back button label).

retry.description: Generic retry action label used on error states across the app.

undo.description: Generic undo action label used on snackbars and other transient confirmations.

daily.description: Bottom-nav label for the Daily tab (home / today’s meditations).

path.description: Bottom-nav label for the Path tab (guided learning course).

explore.description: Bottom-nav label for the Explore tab (library of meditations, talks, techniques).

profile.description: Bottom-nav label for the Profile tab (account, history, favourites, settings).

home_common.description: Shared messages and error toasts on the Home (Daily) tab.

unlock_after_first_meditation.description: Locked-state message shown on Home cards that are gated behind completing the first meditation.

path_coming_soon.description: Placeholder shown when the Path tile on Home is not yet available for the current user/locale.

something_went_wrong.description: Generic error message shown on Home when a section fails to load.

retry.description: Retry CTA used on Home error states.

external_link_coming_soon.description: Toast shown when an external link card on Home is not yet wired up.

card_action_not_available.description: Toast shown when tapping a Home card whose action is not yet implemented.

map_coming_soon.description: Placeholder shown for the in-person class finder on Home before the feature ships.

music_coming_soon.description: Placeholder shown for the music section on Home before the feature ships.

home_load_info.description: Inline info banners on Home that explain why a section is showing fallback content (network or content failure).

top_daily_unavailable.description: Banner shown when the hero Daily meditation could not be resolved at all.

top_daily_failed.description: Banner shown when the hero Daily meditation failed to load due to a network or content error.

top_daily_random.description: Banner shown when the hero Daily meditation has been replaced by a random meditation fallback.

quick_daily_unavailable.description: Banner shown when the Quick meditations row could not be resolved.

quick_daily_failed.description: Banner shown when the Quick meditations row failed to load.

quick_daily_random.description: Banner shown when the Quick meditations row has been replaced by random fallbacks.

home_daily.description: Hero, cards, and CTAs on the Daily tab. Includes the time-of-day hero variants (morning/afternoon/evening) and Path / Talks / Live / In-person promo blocks.

start_meditation.description: Primary CTA on the hero card that begins the suggested meditation.

start_now.description: Compact CTA used on secondary cards to start a meditation immediately.

start_course.description: CTA on the Path promo card when the user has not started the course.

continue_course.description: CTA on the Path promo card when the user has progress to resume.

start_the_course.description: Long-form variant of start_course used in alternate layouts.

continue_the_course.description: Long-form variant of continue_course used in alternate layouts.

scroll_to_the_path.description: Accessibility / link label inviting the user to scroll down to the Path section.

the_path_going_deeper.description: Eyebrow label above the Path promo block (typically uppercase, e.g. 'THE PATH: GOING DEEPER').

your_morning_meditation.description: Hero title used in the morning time-of-day variant.

your_afternoon_meditation.description: Hero title used in the afternoon time-of-day variant.

your_evening_meditation.description: Hero title used in the evening time-of-day variant.

morning_meditation_subtitle.description: Hero subtitle for the morning variant. Preserve the embedded line break (\n) — it controls hero layout.

afternoon_meditation_subtitle.description: Hero subtitle for the afternoon variant. Preserve the embedded line break (\n).

evening_meditation_subtitle.description: Hero subtitle for the evening variant.

path_going_deeper_title.description: Title of the Path promo card on Home. Preserve the embedded line break (\n).

path_going_deeper_subtitle.description: Subtitle of the Path promo card on Home.

learn_from_source.description: Eyebrow label above the Shri Mataji talks section on Home (typically uppercase).

hero_label_get_started.description: Eyebrow chip label on the hero card for pre-activation users (‘Get started’).

hero_label_try_something_new.description: Eyebrow chip label on the hero card encouraging variation.

hero_label_meditate_with_others.description: Eyebrow chip label on the hero card promoting community sessions.

see_more.description: Inline link/CTA to expand a section or view more items.

whats_your_priority_today.description: Eyebrow above the priority chooser on Home, daytime variant (typically uppercase).

set_reminder_for_later.description: CTA opening the 'schedule for later' bottom sheet.

reminder_prompt_subtitle.description: Subtitle of the same scheduling prompt. Preserve the embedded line break (\n).

reminder_prompt_no_thanks.description: Decline CTA on the scheduling prompt.

reminder_sheet_start_first_meditation.description: CTA on the success confirmation suggesting the user starts the first meditation immediately instead.

consent_ad_modal.description: Post-first-meditation ‘Help spread the word’ ad-measurement consent modal. Shown in the onboarding chain after the first-meditation Vibes Interpretation + Shri Mataji talk and before Account Creation. Approval flips adsMarketingConsent = true (see .kiro/specs/analytics-simplified/01-strategy.md §3 and §9). Figma: node-id 11564-91404.

body_intro_prefix.description: First paragraph prefix; combined inline with body_intro_link and body_intro_suffix to form a single sentence. Include any trailing space.

body_intro_link.description: Inline link text inside the first paragraph (e.g. 'what we share'). Tapping opens a detail sheet listing exactly which fields are sent to Meta, Apple and Google Ads.

body_intro_suffix.description: First paragraph suffix completing the sentence after the inline link. Include the leading separator if needed (e.g. ') with Meta, Apple and Google Ads to understand which outreach helps people discover meditation.').

body_benefits.description: Second paragraph explaining the benefits of granting consent (improving campaigns, using donations responsibly, suppressing ads to existing users, reaching similar people).

body_never_share.description: Third paragraph listing categories that are never sent for advertising (mood, goals, hand sensations, reflections, class location, spiritual-practice details). Must remain consistent with the privacy filter in analytics-simplified/03-marketing-event-taxonomy.md §2.

body_never_sell.description: Fourth paragraph: short statement that the app never sells user data.

body_settings_hint.description: Fifth paragraph telling the user they can change this anytime via Settings → Privacy & advertising. Preserve the arrow character (→) or substitute the locale equivalent.

allow.description: Primary CTA granting consent (sets adsMarketingConsent = true).

reject.description: Decline CTA. Decline is a single tap and must not block account creation (see analytics-simplified/05-flutter-implementation.md §9).

consent_settings.description: Profile → Privacy & advertising settings screen — two toggle sections (anonymous product analytics, advertising measurement). Drives the productAnalyticsOptOut and adsMarketingConsent flags respectively (see .kiro/specs/analytics-simplified/05-flutter-implementation.md §2 and §8). Figma: node-id 11571-40337.

screen_title.description: Screen title (e.g. 'Help spread the word and make the app better').

status_allowed.description: Status label shown next to a toggle that is currently allowed. MUST preserve the {date} placeholder — it is replaced at runtime with the localized date of the most recent consent decision (e.g. '16 May 2026').

status_not_allowed.description: Status label shown next to a toggle that is currently disallowed.

product_analytics_title.description: Section title for the anonymous product analytics toggle (e.g. 'Anonymous product analytics'). Drives productAnalyticsOptOut.

product_analytics_description.description: Section body explaining anonymous product analytics: we log aggregated usage data to fix bugs and improve We Meditate, no individual data, no advertisers, no user profile. Must remain consistent with the TelemetryDeck posture in analytics-simplified/01-strategy.md §4.

advertising_title.description: Section title for the advertising-measurement toggle (e.g. 'Advertising measurement and improvement'). Drives adsMarketingConsent.

advertising_body_intro_prefix.description: First paragraph prefix of the advertising section; combined inline with advertising_body_intro_link and advertising_body_intro_suffix. Include any trailing space.

advertising_body_intro_link.description: Inline link text inside the first paragraph (e.g. 'what we share'). Tapping opens the same 'what we share' detail used by the ad consent modal.

advertising_body_intro_suffix.description: First paragraph suffix completing the sentence after the inline link. Include the leading separator if needed.

advertising_body_benefits.description: Second paragraph of the advertising section: how granting consent helps WeMeditate use donations responsibly, improve campaigns, suppress ads to existing users, and reach similar people.

advertising_body_never_share.description: Third paragraph of the advertising section reiterating the never-shared categories (mood, goals, hand sensations, reflections, class location, spiritual-practice details). Must remain consistent with analytics-simplified/03-marketing-event-taxonomy.md §2.

advertising_body_change_hint.description: Fourth paragraph of the advertising section explaining that the user can change their choice anytime using the toggle at the top of this screen.

advertising_platforms_header.description: Sub-section header listing current advertising platforms (e.g. 'Current advertising platforms').

advertising_platform_meta.description: Bullet item for Meta (Facebook + Instagram + Audience Network). Brand name — usually kept as 'Meta'.

advertising_platform_google_ads.description: Bullet item for Google Ads. Brand name — usually kept as 'Google Ads'.

advertising_platform_apple_search_ads.description: Bullet item for Apple Search Ads. Brand name — usually kept as 'Apple Search Ads'.
